title: Hinomori Shizuku — Reaching Out To Something〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: To One Day Reach that Flowery Stage

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: “I can't be there, but I hope you all enjoy the segment I came up with.”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: ...is what Haruka said in her message♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which is why we're going to do our best to make the segment she thought for us a good one! Like she's looking over our shoulder!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I get what you're trying to say, but that last part sounded a bit creepy...

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<What kind of segment?>
<I can't wait!>
<Looking over your shoulder?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's get started!
The segment Haruka came up with is called the...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: “Fast Forward Dance Battle!”

rows.Speaker: Minori & Airi
rows.Line: Yay♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: As the title of this segment suggests, we'll be holding a contest to see who can perform a dance at different speeds with the most precision.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We've prepared four levels of difficulty. Easy, hard, expert and master.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Easy will be only a little bit faster.
Hard is where things become challenging.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, cool! This sounds more like a fun game than a battle!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka even left us a small piece of advice.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: “We're all used to dancing to this song, but everything will quickly fall apart if you don't stay sharp with each move.”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I see.
Then, let's practice a bit on easy mode first!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This isn't so bad!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm doing just fine!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, me too!
Next, we'll try hard mode!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hey, hey, hey, hey!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This is a little fast, but I'm still doing okay!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, we're all doing great!
Next, we'll try expert!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey-hey-hey-hey, hey-hey-hey-hey!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hey-hey-hey-hey, hey-hey-hey-heeey!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hey-hey-hey-hey, hey-hey-hey-hey!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
I was barely able to keep up. Anyway, next is master...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
W-Wait, what...?!
You're kidding, right, Haruka?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hey-hey-hey-hey-hey-hey-hey-heeey!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wow, Minori, you're doing... No, hang on. Only your mouth is moving. How are you doing, Shizuku...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh...? No, wait... Uhh... Now...?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
A-Airi, what do I do...?!
I don't even know when to start.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I don't know either!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Haruka got us good...
But we're not about to give up! Again!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Minori
rows.Line:
Right!
Okay!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: How'd I do...? I feel like I got it right...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That was amazing, Airi!
I can't believe you managed to do it on master!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, that was incredible!
I had trouble just figuring out the timing for it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Can't talk... Out of breath... Close it out for me...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, got it!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I hope you all enjoyed today's stream.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<It was awesome from start to finish!>
<Today's MVP is Airi.>
<You were amazing, Airi!>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<That was the hardest I ever laughed.>
<That was fun! Even though Haruka wasn't here, you all made sure to keep mentioning her!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Oh, this person must be one of her fans. I'm glad to see that they enjoyed everything.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Good work, Airi.
Here, have some water.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Our stream went really well considering it was just the three of us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! And everyone commenting said they had a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This is all because of the suggestion you made that time, Shizuku! I'm so glad you said that we should use Haruka's idea!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Wait, you want to use my idea...?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Yes. By using your idea for our stream, even though you'll be absent, it'll still feel like you're an active participant.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <We'll also make sure to mention you as we talk throughout the segment to make sure your fans stay entertained.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That really was a nice idea.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's also a clue as to how we can put on fun streams moving forward when we're not all present.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you. But I believe you were the reason why our stream went so well today, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You know it! Gimme all the praise you've got!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Shizuku & Airi
rows.Line:
Haha!
Hehe.
